subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should CodexBar accept this four-PR lineage architecture now as a legacy-default shadow foundation while explicitly deferring production authority until the residual and promotion evidence is stronger?
rationale: The implementation is reversible and technically well supported, but it adds a new accounting architecture and policy knob whose future activation changes user-visible totals; the code cannot determine whether the current residual accuracy and maintenance cost fit the product direction.

options.title: Accept the shadow foundation
options.body: Review and land the stack in order with legacy remaining authoritative, then collect more finalized per-day evidence before granting promotion authorization.

options.title: Pause for stronger accuracy
options.body: Keep the stack unmerged until additional representative histories reduce or explain the remaining day-level residuals and exact-head checks are green.

options.title: Retain only shipped containment
options.body: Close the lineage stack and continue with the existing intra-file containment if the added architecture and long-term maintenance surface are not desired.

recommendation.title: Accept the shadow foundation
recommendation.body: Review and land the stack in order with legacy remaining authoritative, then collect more finalized per-day evidence before granting promotion authorization.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and recent direct work on the scanner, cache, and merged containment make this the clearest available product and compatibility decision owner.
